story_info.title: Barnaby Bunny and the Gentle Wind
story_info.subtitle: A calming story about finding peace.
story_info.moral: Listening to soft sounds can help you relax and feel calm.

main_character.name: Barnaby Bunny
main_character.appearance: Barnaby is a small, soft grey-and-white bunny with long floppy ears, round sleepy eyes, and a little pink nose. He has a plush, huggable, storybook-soft look.

cover.prompt: Pixar-quality 3D illustration of Barnaby Bunny, a small, soft grey-and-white bunny with long floppy ears, round sleepy eyes, and a little pink nose, sitting in a glowing Moonlight Meadow at sunset. He is feeling a gentle breeze. Soft glowing flowers are around him. The mood is calm and warm. Vertical composition, Instagram friendly.
cover.visual_action: Barnaby Bunny feeling a gentle breeze

slides.title: A Gentle Evening
slides.text: Barnaby Bunny was in Moonlight Meadow. The sky turned soft pink and orange. A gentle wind began to blow. It felt cool and nice on his ears. "Hello, gentle wind," Barnaby said softly. He loved the quiet evening air.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Barnaby in his favorite place during a calm evening.

slides.title: Listening to the Wind
slides.text: Barnaby sat down on the soft grass. He closed his round, sleepy eyes. He listened to the wind play. It made a soft "whoosh" sound. The sound felt like a gentle hug. Barnaby took a slow, deep breath.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Barnaby engaging his senses to listen to the wind.

slides.title: A Gentle Rocking
slides.text: The gentle wind danced through the tall grass. It made the flower petals sway slowly. Barnaby imagined the wind rocking him. Rocking gently, side to side. He felt warm and very safe. His little body began to relax.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby uses his imagination to connect with the wind's movement.

slides.title: A Sleepy Lullaby
slides.text: The wind sang a soft, quiet tune. It felt like a sweet lullaby. Barnaby listened with a happy smile. His floppy ears twitched a little bit. He felt his tummy feel soft. His legs felt heavy and sleepy.
slides.speaker_notes: Describe how the wind's sound makes Barnaby feel more sleepy and comfortable.

slides.title: Sweet Dreams
slides.text: Barnaby found a perfect comfy spot. He curled into a little ball. The gentle wind sang him to sleep. He felt very, very calm. Barnaby smiled his best sleepy smile. "Sweet dreams begin with a smile!" he thought.
slides.speaker_notes: Conclude with Barnaby feeling deeply calm and ready for sleep, using his catchphrase.
